name: create-lumos-app
description: Scaffolding CLI for Lumos Fellows — create Next.js or Expo apps with best-practice defaults

scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --experimental-test-module-mocks --test test/utils.test.ts test/skills.test.ts test/supabase.test.ts test/scaffold.test.ts test/git.test.ts test/packages.test.ts test/format.test.ts test/templates.test.ts test/anti-slop.test.ts test/agent-guidance.test.ts test/verification.test.ts
scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings bin src scripts test && oxlint bin src scripts test
scripts.format: biome format --write bin src scripts test biome.json package.json tsconfig*.json
scripts.check: biome check --write bin src scripts test && oxlint bin src scripts test
scripts.prerelease: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm lint
